FAQ

Can our clients see the custovox.ai brand anywhere?

No. Full white-label means your brand everywhere — report cover, headers, footers, email delivery. custovox.ai is completely invisible to your end clients.

How many clients can we manage?

The agency plan includes access for up to 10 simultaneous clients. Beyond that, contact us — we offer a custom plan for larger agency portfolios.

Do you offer onboarding support?

Yes. Every agency partner benefits from dedicated onboarding — setup, first client analysis, report template configuration. Our team is available throughout.
